verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes an official Agent Toolkit SDK (npm/PyPI, versioned and actively published) integrating with MCP, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, and Bedrock, plus documented pre-built functions for orders, invoices, subscriptions, refunds, disputes, and catalog management, backed by REST API docs, sandbox testing, and webhooks. This is corroborated by runtime probes confirming the toolkit is live on public registries and the MCP server is reachable. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer reviews/case studies of building against these SDKs beyond PayPal's own docs and registry probes.
